notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Some users reported issues with some levels having glitches. Those have been fixed. Game should run fast and have no major issues now.

For those wanting to delete their save files and set their game to default settings to see the changes please do the following - (Hit windows+r, write %appdata% and click enter or run, delete the folder AppData\Local\Noah and Blackmagician)
